claim: *Heterogeneous models over shared identities.* DocAble maintains several representations for different engineering questions. Stable identities and explicit correspondence allow those representations to be joined when a question crosses them without requiring one universal model of the system.

topology.description: Seven representations joined by shared identity; radial peer organization, not hierarchy.

required_terms: Traceability · derivation · query surfaces Join representations where an engineering question crosses them.

alt: Seven peer representations surround shared system identities: service registry, deployment topology, state machines, entitlement policy, computation graph, provenance records and measurements. Connections to the hub express shared identity, not hierarchy. A separate footer names traceability, derivation and query surfaces. Gray fills distinguish the source semantic roles; labels and line conventions retain their meanings.
